props.label: About Us
props.heading: A car accessories shop that also fits
props.body:
Galaxy Car Decor is a car accessories and decor shop in Nagpur. We stock the full range — interior, audio, lighting, exterior styling and detailing — and we fit all of it ourselves.

That matters more than it sounds. Most accessory problems are fitting problems, not product problems: a player that loses power, damping that rattles after a month, ambient strips that come unstuck in summer, a reverse camera aimed at the bumper. Doing our own fitting is how we stay answerable for it.

Bring the car in and tell us the budget. We will tell you what is worth doing on your model, what genuinely is not, and what it costs before we start.

items.q: Do you fit what you sell, or only sell it?
items.a: We fit everything. That is the whole point of the shop. Most accessory complaints are fitting complaints — a player that drops power, damping that rattles, ambient strips lifting in the summer heat — and doing our own fitting is how we stay answerable for it.

items.q: How long will my car be with you?
items.a: Most interior work — seat covers, matting, steering, chargers, cameras — is same day, often a couple of hours. Ambient lighting and audio depend on how much wiring is involved. Ceramic coating needs a full day or more, because the preparation is most of the job and rushing it is exactly why coatings fail.

items.q: Will an android player or extra wiring affect my car's warranty?
items.a: Fitted correctly, tapped off the right points and with nothing cut that should not be, it should not. Tell us your car is still under warranty before we start and we will do it the careful way and keep it reversible.

items.q: Do you work on all car models?
items.a: Hatchback, sedan and SUV, most makes. A few accessories genuinely do not suit some models — we would rather tell you that than sell you something that will sit badly.

items.q: Can you tell me the price before I bring the car?
items.a: For most items, yes — call or WhatsApp us with your car model and what you want. For paint and coating work we would rather see the car first, because the condition of the paint decides the work.
